bio.text: Jefferson Shreve was elected to the 119th Congress and represents Indiana's 6th District; he serves on the House Appropriations Committee.
He founded the real estate company Storage Express, served on the board of Extra Space, and served two terms on the Indianapolis City-County Council.
He graduated from Indiana University, earned a master's degree in international studies and diplomacy from the University of London, and holds an MBA in agribusiness from Purdue University.
